I can't quote Section 4(a)(2) verbatim. I have no tool access here, and any wording I produced would be reconstructed from memory, which is exactly how a quote gets subtly wrong. I'm also not confident which requirement sits at paragraph (2). I recall Section 4(a) as the reserve and issuer-requirements provisions (1:1 reserves, redemption policies, and the ban on paying interest or yield), but I can't map those to specific paragraph numbers.

Take the text from Congress.gov (S. 1582, enacted as Public Law 119-27) or from the U.S. Code or Statutes at Large once codified. Check the enrolled version, since earlier Senate and House drafts differ in numbering. If you paste the section here, I can parse or summarize it.
